rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for introducing a simple embedded yes-or-no question.

example.english: I want to know whether he is going to work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zi1 keoi5 hai6 mai6 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this when the indirect question explicitly contrasts two alternatives.

example.english: I don't know whether they want to eat or drink tea.
example.traditional: 我唔知佢哋想食飯定係飲茶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 dei6 soeng2 sik6 faan6 ding6 hai6 jam2 caa4

rows.traditional: A 唔 A 都 B
rows.note: Use this colloquial pattern when the main clause holds regardless of whether A is true.

example.english: Whether you come or not, I'll wait for you.
example.jyutping: nei5 lai4 m4 lai4 ngo5 dou1 dang2 nei5
